relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: born in an orthodox Brahmin family on 7 November 1891, at Bhatpara, West Bengal to Pandit Ramprasanna Bhattacharyya, a scholar at the princely court of Krishnanagar and a Sanskrit scholar.

relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: Bhattacharyya joined Calcutta's Scottish Church College from where he graduated in 1912.

relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: He obtained a master's degree in philosophy from the University of Calcutta in 1914, and a law degree in 1917.

relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: Bhattacharyya joined the Scottish Church College in 1915, as a lecturer of philosophy and logic.

relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: Later in 1917, he began teaching philosophy and experimental psychology at the University of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: After the University of Dhaka was established in 1921, he joined the department of philosophy as a Reader.

relations.subject: Haridas Bhattacharyya
relations.evidence: After the partition of 1947, he relocated to the department of Indology at the Banaras Hindu University.
